title: memoir session state file (session.json)
description: The live working set plus bounded history — the 'hot' half of a memoir store. Normative text: docs/SPEC.md v0.1 (draft), sections 4-5. Matches what the reference implementation (memoir-cli src/session/state.js, schema version 1) reads and writes. Unknown fields are permitted everywhere by design: readers ignore them, writers preserve them.

version.description: Schema version of this file. (Named `version` here and `schema_version` in entry frontmatter; both names are deployed.) Forward-version rule: quarantine + degrade, never guess (SPEC.md section 6).

machines.description: Stable machine UUID -> { label, last_seen }. UUIDs must never change; labels (hostnames) may. Merge keeps the newer last_seen per UUID.

current.description: The live working set. Lists are bounded (caps are implementation quality parameters, but SOME cap is normative) and merge by union-by-normalized-text, newest date wins, tombstones sticky (SPEC.md section 5).

completed_actions.description: Temporal tombstones for next_actions. MAY be absent in files written before any completion; readers treat absence as empty. Retention must outlive any stale replica that might still carry the completed item, or completions resurrect on merge (SPEC.md 5.3.2).

parked_actions.description: Overflow from next_actions (SPEC.md 4.1, 5.2): when the live list is full the oldest actions move here instead of being dropped. Still open, still rendered, still completable; re-adding one returns it to next_actions. MAY be absent; readers treat absence as empty. v0.1.2.

completed_goals.description: Temporal tombstones for goals, same rule as completed_actions with set_on in place of added (SPEC.md 5.3.2). MAY be absent. v0.1.2.

history.description: Bounded roll-up of past sessions, newest first, deduplicated by (date, machine_id, summary).

added.description: Merge recency key, and the field compared against a tombstone's done_at: added <= done_at is suppressed; added > done_at is a deliberate revival and survives.
Original add time — still the merge recency key and the tombstone comparison field.

parked_at.description: When the action overflowed the live list.

rejected.description: The rejected alternative. (Deployed field name; not rejected_alternative.)

hidden.description: true = absolute tombstone. Sticky and monotonic across merges REGARDLESS of the date comparison: if any copy on either side is hidden, the merged copy is hidden (SPEC.md 5.3.1).

text_hash.description: Purged tombstone (SPEC.md 5.3.1): SHA-256 of the normalized identity text this entry replaced. Only valid together with hidden:true; text is the literal "[purged]".

session_id.description: Transcript/session identifier; when present, history dedupes by it and a session updates its own row in place (v0.1.2).
